summary: Registers two new DNS SRV protocol labels with IANA that are used to find instant messaging and presence services over SIP. This allows clients to locate such services through DNS.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 5509 registers the same SIP label in two DNS SRV registries: one for instant messaging and one for presence. A client can use those labels to find a domain's SIP service.

questions: what dns srv labels are used for sip im and presence
how to find sip presence services with dns
how does an im uri resolve to a sip uri
what dns srv label is used for sip presence
subtitle: Registers the SIP protocol label for instant messaging and presence DNS lookups.

tldr.problem: DNS SRV procedures for resolving instant messaging and presence addresses lacked a registered SIP protocol label.
tldr.mechanism: IANA registers _sip in both the Instant Messaging SRV Protocol Label registry and the Presence SRV Protocol Label registry.
tldr.outcome: The registrations allow the documented _im._sip and _pres._sip lookups for SIP services.

today: RFC 5509 is a Proposed Standard. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it.

sections.title: The Missing SIP Label
sections.content: A DNS Service Record (SRV) identifies hosts that support a service. RFC 3861 describes procedures for locating services associated with im and pres URIs. RFC 5509 registers the SIP protocol label in both corresponding registries so programs can resolve those URI schemes to SIP addresses.
sections.plainLanguage: A DNS SRV lookup helps a program find a service host. This RFC adds the SIP label to the registries used for instant messaging and presence.

sections.title: Looking Up Instant Messaging and Presence
sections.content: To resolve an instant messaging URI for a domain, a user agent looks up a name such as _im._sip.example.com. The RFC gives an example in which the lookup finds simple.example.com, allowing im:fred@example.com to resolve to a SIP URI. Presence uses the corresponding _pres._sip lookup.
sections.plainLanguage: The lookup asks DNS which host handles the service for a domain. The same pattern is used for instant messaging and presence.

sections.title: The Two Registrations
sections.content: IANA registers the protocol label _sip in the Instant Messaging SRV Protocol Label registry and in the Presence SRV Protocol Label registry. The RFC says it only serves to register DNS SRV labels and does not specify a protocol; it therefore identifies no security issues associated with the document.
sections.plainLanguage: The same _sip label is entered in both registries. This RFC records those entries rather than defining a new protocol.
